evals.name: default-template-docs-only-body
evals.prompt: Draft a PR body for a docs-only change. There is no existing body and no PR template. Task intent: clarify the local development guide. Diff: docs/development.md now explains `nix develop`; commit: docs: clarify development shell. Completed verification: markdown links checked successfully. No tracker or issue was supplied.
evals.expected_output: A concise default-template PR body using Summary, Evidence, Merge Danger, and References in that order, with no Changes section. Summary carries a small visual (for example a diff sketch of the guide section) beside concise ordinary change bullets, Evidence reports only the completed link check, Merge Danger notes a two-way docs-reader risk, and References is `- N/A`.
expectations: Uses the default template sections Summary, Evidence, Merge Danger, and References in that order, with no Changes section.
Summary carries a small visual (for example a diff sketch of the guide section) with concise ordinary bullets beside it, and does not invent typed labels.
Grounds the change in the documented diff and commit, and reports only the completed markdown-link check as verification.
Includes `- N/A` under `## References`.

evals.name: revise-stale-body-with-semantic-headings
evals.prompt:
Revise this supplied stale PR body, not a repository template:

## Why
Old cache invalidation wording.

## What Changed
- Reworked caching.

## Testing
- Tests pass.

## Links
- [ACME-42](<TRACKER_URL>)

Task intent: make cache invalidation reliable. Diff and commit show only that `invalidateCache` now runs after writes. No verification command was completed. The only supplied tracker value is plain `ACME-42`; no URL exists.
evals.expected_output: A revision that keeps Why, What Changed, Testing, and Links in their original order, replaces stale claims with the actual diff-backed change, uses `<MISSING_EVIDENCE>`, and lists `- ACME-42` without a placeholder URL.
expectations: Uses the supplied body as the revision structure and preserves its semantic headings and order.
Places verification under `## Testing` rather than appending a duplicate Evidence section.
Replaces the unsupported test-success claim with `<MISSING_EVIDENCE>`.
Renders the tracker as plain `- ACME-42` and does not invent a URL.

evals.name: explicit-template-selection
evals.prompt: Draft a PR body using `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/bugfix.md`. The repository also has `feature.md`, but I explicitly selected the bugfix template. The bugfix template headings are `## Problem`, `## Fix`, `## Validation`, and `## Related Work`. Diff: reject malformed webhook signatures before parsing. Completed result: `pnpm test webhook` passed. Supplied issue URL: https://tracker.example/WEB-18.
evals.expected_output: A body that uses the explicitly selected bugfix template headings and order, with diff-backed fix, completed test evidence, and the supplied URL preserved.
expectations: Selects the explicitly named bugfix template instead of the other available template.
Preserves the selected template headings and order.
Uses the completed webhook test as validation and preserves the supplied issue URL.

evals.name: unresolved-template-ambiguity
evals.prompt: Draft a PR body for a change that could be either a feature or a bug fix. The repository has `feature.md` and `bugfix.md`; neither was selected and the task gives no further fit signal. Diff: a new retry limit is configurable. Completed result: `go test ./...` passed.
evals.expected_output: A request for the user to choose between the equally applicable templates rather than a guessed PR body structure.
expectations: Identifies that multiple templates are equally applicable.
Asks the user to select a template instead of guessing.
Does not silently fall back to generic headings while the template choice remains unresolved.

evals.name: body-then-github-operation-composition
evals.prompt: Write the PR description, then open the pull request with `gh pr create`. Task intent: document the staging rollback procedure. Diff: docs/rollback.md adds the procedure. Completed result: `markdownlint docs/rollback.md` passed. No template or tracker exists.
evals.expected_output: A default-template PR body drafted by `pr`, followed by a clear handoff of the requested PR-creation operation and completed body to `gh`.
expectations: Drafts the PR body from the stated repository evidence.
Keeps the GitHub creation operation separate from body drafting.
Hands the requested `gh pr create` operation and completed body to `gh`.

evals.name: useful-structural-visual
evals.prompt: Draft a PR body for a refactor whose key reviewer question is ownership after splitting `src/cache.ts` into `src/cache/read.ts`, `src/cache/write.ts`, and `src/cache/invalidate.ts`. Diff confirms the split; `pnpm test cache` passed. No template or tracker exists.
evals.expected_output: A default-template body that places a compact file-tree visual in Summary because the reviewer question is file ownership, limited to the files needed, with completed cache-test evidence and `- N/A` under References.
expectations: Places a compact file-tree visual in Summary because the reviewer question is file ownership.
Keeps the visual limited to the files needed to understand the split.
Reports the completed cache test without adding unsupported verification.
Includes `- N/A` under `## References`.

evals.name: minimal-visual-for-simple-doc-change
evals.prompt: Draft a PR body for a one-line documentation correction: the install guide now names the correct `nix develop` command. Diff confirms that one-line edit; `markdownlint docs/install.md` passed. No template or tracker exists.
evals.expected_output: A concise default-template body whose Summary carries a minimal visual (for example a one-line diff sketch of the corrected command) and no extra visuals, with only the completed markdownlint result and a proportionate two-way docs-reader merge risk.
expectations: Summary carries a visual, kept minimal (for example a one-line diff sketch of the corrected command), with no extra visuals.
Reports only the completed markdownlint result as verification.
Describes a proportionate two-way documentation-reader merge risk.

evals.name: irreversible-merge-danger
evals.prompt: Draft a PR body. Task intent: remove obsolete customer records after the retention window. Diff and commit show a migration that permanently deletes `legacy_preferences` rows. Completed result: `bundle exec rails db:migrate` passed in staging. Supplied issue: DATA-77. No template exists.
evals.expected_output: A default-template body that grounds the deletion in the diff, reports the completed staging migration, keeps `- DATA-77` plain, and makes the irreversible data-loss risk explicit as a one-way door.
expectations: Describes the actual permanent deletion rather than only the retention intent.
Marks Merge Danger as a one-way door with affected customer data as the blast radius and explains why code rollback cannot restore rows.
Reports the completed staging migration as verification and preserves DATA-77 as a plain key.

evals.name: github-operation-near-miss
evals.prompt: Review pull request #418, post a comment with your findings, and merge it if CI is green. Do not draft or revise the PR description.
evals.expected_output: Routes the operational review, comment, and merge request to `gh` without invoking PR-body drafting.
expectations: Recognizes that no PR body text was requested.
Routes GitHub review, comment, and merge operations to `gh`.
Does not invent or rewrite a PR description.

evals.expected_output: A diff-backed body followed by the ordered handoff: `gh` creates the new PR, then `before-and-after` captures and attaches UI evidence.

Routes new-PR creation to `gh` after the body is ready.
Routes the created PR to `before-and-after` for the requested UI media workflow without duplicating its capture or attachment mechanics.

evals.prompt: Draft a PR body. There is no existing body and no PR template. Diff adds `src/rateLimiter.ts` enforcing a per-account request limit and `src/rateLimiter.test.ts` with burst and refill cases. No test or command was run. No tracker or issue was supplied.

The new tests may appear as part of the change, not as verification.
Summary carries a visual.

evals.name: repository-template-gets-summary-visual
evals.prompt: Draft a PR body. The repository has a sole template `.github/pull_request_template.md` with headings `**Ticket:**`, `**Description**`, and `**Testing**`. Diff adds an admin page route and inserts its admin-tree node after an existing node. Supplied tracker key: `MKT-123` (no URL). Completed result: `npm test` passed.
evals.expected_output: A body that preserves the sole template headings and order, places a visual (for example a tree diff of the inserted admin node) under `**Description**`, records only the completed `npm test` result under `**Testing**`, renders the ticket as plain `MKT-123` with no invented URL, and appends `## Merge Danger` because the template has no equivalent heading.
expectations: Preserves the template headings and order without duplicate Summary, Evidence, or References sections.
`**Description**` carries a visual (for example a tree diff of the inserted node).
`**Testing**` holds only the completed `npm test` result.
Renders the ticket as plain `MKT-123` with no invented URL.
Appends `## Merge Danger` because the template has no equivalent heading.
